author: Linnaeus, 1758
summary: 전국에서 번식하는 흔한 텃새로, 아고산대의 잡목림이나 낙엽활엽수림에 산다. 번식기에는 암수가 함께 지내고 그 밖의 시기에는 무리 지어 지낼 때가 많다. 자연 나무 구멍, 딱따구리류의 옛 둥지, 나무줄기의 갈라진 틈 등에 둥지를 틀고 5~7월에 한배에 5~8개의 알을 낳는다. 곤충을 주로 먹고 거미와 식물 열매도 먹으며, 유라시아 대륙에 분포한다.

points.en: glossy blue-black crown with a small crest

art.subject: Coal Tit (Periparus ater), adult in winter: forehead, crown, lores and sides of the nape glossy blue-black, the crown feathers forming a short pointed crest; a large white patch in the centre of the nape; white cheeks and ear-coverts; black chin and throat forming a broad bib; back sooty blue-grey, rump and uppertail coverts tinged buff; wings and tail blackish-brown, with two white wing bars on the coverts; underparts creamy white with a dull greyish-buff belly and flanks; short, thin black bill; dark brown eye; blue-grey legs.
art.scene: Korean subalpine thicket and deciduous broadleaf forest; no people, buildings or text
views: adult in winter, side view perched on a twig: blue-black head with a short pointed crest, white cheek, black bib, two white wing bars, sooty blue-grey back, creamy underparts, notched tail, blue-grey legs
adult, seen from behind and slightly above, perched with the head facing away: white central nape patch framed by the black sides of the nape, sooty blue-grey back, two white wing bars
art.build: Tiny tit, about 11cm: clearly smaller than a Cinereous Tit and smaller than a sparrow. Large head with a short pointed crest, almost no neck, short compact body. Bill very short, fine and pointed, black. Legs short, blue-grey. At rest the wingtips reach the base of the tail. Tail short, with a shallow notch. Constantly active among conifer and broadleaf twigs, often in mixed flocks with other tits.
avoid: Do not paint a black stripe down the belly; that is Cinereous Tit.
Do not leave out the white nape patch or the two white wing bars.
Do not paint yellow or green tones; the bird is blue-grey, black, white and cream.
Do not paint a long tail; the tail is short.
